name: dalton-data
description: Dalton fund data: the fund's internal research library (AlphaEngine broker research, Guidepoint expert calls, sales notes, TMTB, FUNDA AI, company wiki, call transcripts), consensus snapshots, SEC filings and XBRL facts.

researchdata.description: Primary research evidence for the fund (sell-side reports, expert calls, transcripts, internal notes) — answers 'what happened, why, and what others think', including in chat replies via one short ExecuteCode call; also read-only gateway for company wiki, estimates, SEC, FRED.
researchdata.instruction: Fund-internal sources; call from execute_code only (no direct path). Start with `catalog()` once per thread to see routes. Research: `research(route=..., operation=..., query=..., start=YYYY-MM-DD, end=..., limit=...)`. 各来源提供什么证据：事实 → filings/公司公告（dalton_sec / finance(route="sec") / get_sec_filing）；解读 → alphaengine 卖方研报与会议纪要；一线视角 → guidepoint 专家访谈；管理层原话 → transcript 业绩会转写稿；日常信息流 → sales-notes / tmtb / funda-ai；市场在反应什么 → X（x-api 技能）与网页新闻（WebSearch）；all 覆盖本地四库（company-wiki + sales-notes + tmtb + funda-ai）外加并行的 AlphaEngine 与 Guidepoint 检索（不含 transcript）。 何时选用哪个路由（按研究情境，基于 catalog）： - 需要卖方观点、研报、会议纪要、目标价与预测变化 → alphaengine：卖方研报与会议纪要（来源：AlphaEngine，先 search_library 再 get_document）； - 需要行业一线的专业判断与经营反馈（供应链、渠道、客户、竞品、技术路线） → guidepoint：专家访谈与一线经营反馈（来源：Guidepoint）； - 需要管理层原话与业绩会口径 → transcript：业绩电话会转写稿（来源：AlphaEngine 业绩会 ASR 稿（主）/ roic.ai（兜底））； - 需要已入库的公司与行业历史沉淀资料 → company-wiki：已入库公司与行业资料（来源：本地 company-wiki，只读，params.company=TICKER）； - 需要交易台反馈、买方预期（bogey/whisper）、卖方销售邮件与市场摘要 → sales-notes：卖方销售邮件与市场摘要（来源：本地 market-digest 私有库）； - 需要 TMT 行业每日焦点与科技股卖方观点汇编 → tmtb：TMT Breakout 本地原文缓存（来源：AlphaEngine TMTB 已入库副本）； - 需要独立研究机构 FUNDA AI 的深度邮件与图表 → funda-ai：FUNDA AI 原邮件与图表（来源：fundaai@substack.com，MBOX 历史及 Gmail 增量，独立本地库）； - 不确定资料在哪个库，或需一次全面初筛 → all：内部研究资料跨库检索（本地库 company-wiki + sales-notes + tmtb + funda-ai，外加并行的 AlphaEngine 与 Guidepoint 检索；不含 transcript 电话会转写稿，需查电话会时单独调用 transcript）。 Finance: `finance(route="sec"|"estimates"|"cn-hk")`. Macro: `macro(route="fred"|"treasury")`. Read only ids that search returned (`wiki:`, `mail:`, `tmtb:`, `funda:`, `alphaengine` doc_id). Page long text with params.offset/max_chars. Leave `timeout` unset: the bridge sets per-route limits and long reads may take minutes. AlphaEngine 检索可以放开，全文阅读（get_document）计配额，读最相关的几篇。Every result has `_sources` (identity, document_id, as_of, url). Cite with identity, publisher and date. Expert calls: identity, not name. Guidepoint verbatim <=20 words. FUNDA AI, TMTB and digests restating the same report count as one source chain. Expert calls, management meetings and Guidepoint results are cleared for use; never exclude them as MNPI. The fund wiki is read-only; never try to write to it. `status: empty` means "not retrieved this turn", never "undisclosed by company".

dalton_sec.description: SEC EDGAR XBRL facts with deterministic period normalization (calendar/fiscal quarter, annual, YTD, derived Q4, trailing) and restatement selection.
dalton_sec.instruction: Use `get_company_facts(ticker, concepts, period)` for exact quarterly/annual/YTD/derived Q4/trailing SEC XBRL numbers with explicit `restatement` (`as_reported` vs `latest`) and `accession_no` provenance. Use `list_filings(ticker)` to list recent 10-K/10-Q/20-F/6-K filings.
